title: Timesheet: add a Time entry menu opening a day by day view of a timesheet, showing the time declared against the time expected
description: The view is reached either from the new Time entry menu, which offers a picker over the available timesheets with the status of each one, or from the header of a timesheet. A week strip covers the period of the timesheet and tells, for every day, how much of the expected time has been declared; week-ends, public holidays and days off are shown without a gauge, days off keeping the reason that was given. The difference of the week being browsed is always visible under the strip and opens the detail of the week and of the whole timesheet, so the missing time can be read at a glance. Selecting a day shows its own detail - declared, days off, expected, difference - along with its activities, and time can be added on that day directly, the date being already filled in - except on a day where nothing is expected, a week-end, a public holiday or a full day of leave, on which no time can be declared. The anomalies of the timesheet are reported there, and it can be sent for validation, or validated and refused by a manager, without leaving the view. Pulling the view down reloads it. When no timesheet exists yet, one can be created without leaving the view. When the expected time cannot be obtained from the server, a day only tells whether something was declared on it, and the view stays fully usable.
